name: update_reference_note
title: Reference Note
description: Create, review, or update a narrative paper reference note while preserving source provenance, verification limits, and the requested edit scope

note_path.description: Requested reference-note path; preserve an existing filename rather than creating a competing note

request.description: Task instructions, requested source coverage, research framing, and any explicit scope beyond the note

manuscript_path.description: Optional manuscript source used to identify the paper's argument, citation roles, and cited works

bibliography_path.description: Optional canonical bibliography used to map keys and aliases to works; read-only unless bibliography edits are explicitly requested

sources.description: Optional source URLs or local source paths; a supplied location is not itself evidence that the source has been inspected

dry_run.description: Preview proposed note changes without modifying project files; review-only instructions also require read-only behavior

sources_checked.description: Source material actually inspected during this task, excluding links merely copied from existing notes

unresolved.description: Unverified source details, unclear manuscript connections, or other remaining reference-specific questions
